question: What are the names of the venues where the Khelo India Para Games (KIPG) 2025 was held?

options.text: Jawaharlal Nehru Indoor Stadium, Indira Gandhi Indoor Stadium, and Talkatora Stadium
Jawaharlal Nehru Indoor Stadium and Indira Gandhi Indoor Stadium
Major Dhyan Chand National Stadium, Indira Gandhi Indoor Stadium, and Dr Karni Singh Shooting Range
Jawaharlal Nehru Indoor Stadium, Indira Gandhi Indoor Stadium, and Dr Karni Singh Shooting Range

solution:
The correct answer is __**Jawaharlal Nehru Indoor Stadium, Indira Gandhi Indoor Stadium, and Dr Karni Singh Shooting Range**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The Khelo India Para Games (KIPG) 2025 was held at **Jawaharlal Nehru Indoor Stadium, Indira Gandhi Indoor Stadium, and Dr Karni Singh Shooting Range**, which are prominent sports venues in India.
 
• **Jawaharlal Nehru Indoor Stadium** is located in Delhi and is a multi-purpose indoor sports venue known for hosting large-scale national and international events.
 
• **Indira Gandhi Indoor Stadium**, also situated in Delhi, is one of the largest indoor stadiums in India and is frequently used for multi-sport competitions.
 
• **Dr Karni Singh Shooting Range**, located in New Delhi, is a world-class shooting range used for major shooting championships and training.
 
• The inclusion of these venues reflects the importance of accessible infrastructure for athletes with disabilities, emphasizing India's commitment to promoting para-sports.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Khelo India Programme:**

 
 
• Khelo India is a national sports development initiative launched by the Government of India to promote sports culture at the grassroots level and encourage young talent.
 
• The programme focuses on infrastructure development, athlete training, and enhancing participation in sports across all age groups.
 
 
 
• **Para Sports in India:**
 
 
• Para sports are adapted sports designed for athletes with physical and intellectual disabilities.
 
• India has seen significant growth in para sports, with athletes excelling in events like the Paralympics and World Championships.
 
 
 
• **Dr Karni Singh Shooting Range:**
 
 
• Named after Maharaja Karni Singh of Bikaner, the range is a state-of-the-art facility for shooting sports.
 
• It is equipped to host international competitions and has been the venue for events like the Commonwealth Games.
 
 
 
• **Accessibility in Sports Infrastructure:**
 
 
• India is making significant strides in ensuring sports venues are accessible for athletes with disabilities.
 
• Facilities like ramps, lifts, and specialized equipment are being integrated to support para-athletes.
